body: Fixed in 7e06a76dc. PREPARED and the private sealed artifact now carry the exact origin and domain version used for encryption. Finish compares that same pair with its current preparation; a mismatch raises notification_reprepare, rolls the entire C2 transaction back to PENDING, and the same intent can explicitly re-prepare and seal the current origin. No definer ACL or lock order changed. Tests-first CI116 was RED: https://github.com/humaux/live_commerce_architecture_v1/actions/runs/38484018646 . CI118 at 55c401a23 is GREEN: TestOrderAttemptNotificationOriginPin/switch_origin and /same_origin_version both pass using the actual job-insert barrier and domain definers; independent decryption verifies the retry ciphertext. The full notification group is PASS=13 FAIL=0 SKIP=0, exit 0, job 115600579438: https://github.com/humaux/live_commerce_architecture_v1/actions/runs/38486157297/job/115600579438 . This pins the prepared value at finish; it does not claim later domain administration is immutable. Whole-PR required Foundation remains blocked by the separately owned CI-DRIFT-FACTORY scanner issue.
